claims.text: Elijah Wood played Frodo Baggins in Peter Jackson's The Lord of the Rings trilogy (2001 to 2003).
Sean Astin, Dominic Monaghan and Billy Boyd played the other three hobbits of the Fellowship: Sam, Merry and Pippin.
Peter Jackson filmed all three Lord of the Rings films back to back, in one long shoot.
Peter Jackson was born in New Zealand, and the trilogy was filmed there.
